name: 波波拉
evolution: 水蓝蓝 → 波波拉 Lv.16 → 水灵 Lv.36 → 圣水守护
evolutionEn: Cerulla → Bobola Lv.16 → Shuiling Lv.36 → Shengshuishouhu
description: 在水中自如地游动，头上的触角可以感受水中的变化，总是带着一颗球一样的东西。身旁环绕着特殊的水元素，水元素凝结体中蕴含魔法能量的波动。
descriptionEn: Swims freely in water; the antennae on its head can sense changes in the water, and it always carries a ball-like object. Special water elements surround it, and the water element condensates contain fluctuations of magical energy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%, counters attacks.

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 甩水
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, restores 1 energy to itself.

skills.name: 气泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 水泡盾
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己获得魔攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%; countering attacks: gains M.ATK +70%.

skills.name: 水炮
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; after each use, this skill's energy cost is permanently -1.

skills.name: 洗礼
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，并获得全技能能耗-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Removes its own debuffs and gains all skills energy cost -1.

skills.name: 泡沫幻影
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 80%; countering attacks: it withdraws.

skills.name: 涌泉
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能能耗每-1，威力+10。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each -1 of this skill's energy cost, power +10.

skills.name: 落雨
skills.description: 将天气改为雨天，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to rain for 8 turns.

skills.name: 潮汐
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：自己获得1层湿润印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 60%; countering attacks: gains 1 stack of Damp Mark.

skills.name: 天洪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本技能能耗永久-6。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; countering status: this skill's energy cost is permanently -6.
